scripts.dev: node scripts/copy-runtime.cjs && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-ts,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
